name: pending-ip-exhaustion
why_hard: Pods are Pending and the node looks healthy: plenty of CPU and memory, no pressure conditions. The obvious guesses are a scheduler problem or resource limits. The real cause is that the VPC CNI has run out of pod IPs on the node's ENIs after a scale-up, which shows only as a sandbox-creation failure in the events, not in any metric about the node.

annotations.description: Pod checkout/checkout-web has been in a non-ready state for longer than 15 minutes.
